summary: Platform-agnostic Project metadata HTTP service: project directory reads, Project metadata replication (/loro/:id/metadata) and API token listing over injected ports.
context_hints: No platform SDK, Durable Object, Loro document, better-auth or ORM in this package; Cloudflare (D1/ProjectRoom) and Node (Postgres) adapters live in their apps

The wire contract (paths, status codes, error bodies, JSON shapes) is api-cf's; apps/api-cf/src/metadata-worker.parity.test.ts compares this service with api-cf's in-process routes on the same database
IdentityVerifier may answer "defer" when the platform's auth library must write (sliding session refresh); the service then hands the request to ports.defer (api-cf in-process) unchanged
Import schemas from @clash/shared-types subpaths only, never the barrel

key_files.src/previews.ts: Project card asset preview selection (placed media nodes first, then imported Asset refs).
key_files.src/memory.ts: In-memory adapters for tests and the Node smoke composition.
